verdict.rationale: doola's Partner API supports headless, programmatic automation. Users can self-manage API keys, use sandbox keys that never trigger real filings or charges, call sandbox-only endpoints to complete milestones on demand, retry safely with idempotency keys, and branch on machine-readable error codes. Together these support automated test runs. However, the evidence never documents CI pipelines, a CLI, or a published OpenAPI spec (all probed OpenAPI paths returned 404), so the CI part of the story is only implied. missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation or examples, an official CLI or published OpenAPI spec for headless tooling, independent or hands-on corroboration of automated/CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The doola Partner API lets you create customers, submit company formations (LLC or C-Corp), retrieve formation documents, and look up reference data.
Sandbox keys never trigger real state filings or charges.
Two sandbox-only endpoints complete the formation and EIN milestones on demand, firing the real webhooks, so you can exercise your whole integration
Retrying with the same key and the same body returns the original result and never creates a duplicate.
Every error carries a machine readable code, so you can branch on it without parsing strings.
signed-in Partner Portal users create, revoke and delete keys themselves, and you can hold several at once.
